title: Bus Picton to Nelson | InterCity New Zealand
lines: Catch an InterCity® bus Picton to Nelson. Buses depart from outside the Picton Ferry terminal and connect with Interislander ferry services from Wellington.
The journey from Picton to Nelson takes approximately 2 hours and 20 minutes.
For local Nelson bus information and timetables see nelsoncoaches.co.nz . For ideas on what to do in Nelson check out nelsonnz.com
